id_hook: Squares, mirrors and exact values at 30°, 45°, 60°.
id_step_intro_caption: The point makes a right triangle. Its hypotenuse is 1.
id_step_pythagoras_caption: The two small squares always fill the big one.
id_step_negative_caption: −θ mirrors in the x-axis. Cosine stays, sine flips.
id_step_supplement_caption: 180° − θ mirrors in the y-axis. Sine stays, cosine flips.
id_step_supplement_predict_caption: Where will the mirror point of 180° − θ land?
id_step_supplement_answer_caption: Mirrored in the y-axis. Its height matches the original.
id_step_complement_caption: 90° − θ mirrors in the diagonal. Sine and cosine swap.
id_step_square45_caption: Half a unit square gives the legs √2/2.
id_step_triangle3060_caption: Half an equilateral triangle gives 1/2 and √3/2.
id_step_special_caption: Drag near 30°, 45°, 60° and the point snaps.
